enchantments.tooltip: Absorb Doomsphere Spells: This effect absorbs most spells cast by doomsphere eyestalks. Only a few such spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to dissipate the energy.
Deathblock VII: Passive: 21% Enhancement Bonus to Negative Energy Absorption. In addition, you are immune to magical effects that can cause instant death.
Intelligence +11: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Wizardry X: This item grants the wearer +250 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
Spell Save +1: This item gives a +1 Enhancement bonus to your saves versus spells.
